## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Genoa, Italy. It starts at Ponte Spinola.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Sure, it _looks_ like half a giant clear golf ball sitting on Genoa's Old Port, but this amazing 'Glass Bubble' has over 150 different species of tropical plants, trees, and flowers packed inside! _La Biosfera_ is bursting with tropical beauty, just behind the Genoa Aquarium!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €6.82. It was rated 4.0 out of 5 from 145 ratings and 70 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
